admin/editor.slider-layout.title: Slider Layout
admin/editor.slider-layout.sliderFullWid: Controls whether the slides should fill the full available width, making the arrows appear on top of them.
admin/editor.slider-layout.aspectRatioDe: Reserves space for each slide's content using a CSS aspect-ratio (e.g. 16/9), preventing layout shift while the content loads. Optional: leave empty to keep the current behavior. Takes precedence over Min height when both are set.
admin/editor.slider-layout.minHeightDesc: Reserves a minimum height, in pixels, for each slide's content, preventing layout shift while the content loads. Optional: leave empty to keep the current behavior. Ignored when Aspect ratio is set.
